messages.subject: Update to v0.64.0
messages.body_plain:
Hello, I have made an update to v0.64.0.

There was an error in some situations when returning permutation p-values by the function "SPM". This has been corrected.
"plot_rich_norm" should now work for more than 2 groups. It will also work with multi-subject data; it collapses across "Study.ID" and plots the group means

You can see the changes on the Github page <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/d8ce16a24a892f29241107d8cdee41e5dbf424e4?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3>.

Chris

messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Model Residuals help
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ozgun, I am glad you were able to get things working.

Regarding the "g.L" and plotting, I did not include all of the code that goes into creating that graph object. This is because it is generally quite a hassle, and I think it is much easier to use "plot_brainGraph_gui"; then, if you would like to plot the left hemisphere only, you can simply select the appropriate GUI option.

However, for your information, below will be the code to create the single-hemisphere graph:
----
memb.hemi <- which(V(g[[1]][[N]])$hemi == 'L')
g.sub <- induced.subgraph(g[[1]][[N]], memb.hemi)
for (att in graph_attr_names(g.sub)) g.sub <- delete_graph_attr(g.sub, att)
for (att in vertex_attr_names(g.sub)) g.sub <- delete_vertex_attr(g.sub, att)
for (att in edge_attr_names(g.sub)) g.sub <- delete_edge_attr(g.sub, att)
V(g.sub)$name <- V(g[[1]][[N]])$name[memb.hemi]
V(g.sub)$hemi <- V(g[[1]][[N]])$hemi[memb.hemi]
g.L <- graph.intersection(g[[1]][[N]], g.sub, keep.all.vertices=F)

atlas.dt <- eval(parse(text=data(list=atlas)))
layout.g.L <- matrix(c(-atlas.dt[memb.hemi, y.mni],
                       atlas.dt[memb.hemi, z.mni]),
                   ncol=2, byrow=F)
xlim.g.L <- c(-85, 110)
ylim.g.L <- c(-85, 125)

# Plot with vertex and edge colors representing communities, vertex size proportional to "degree", and edge width proportional to betweenness
plot_brainGraph_mni('sagittal', slice=30, hemi='left')
plot_brainGraph(g.L, vertex.label=NA, vertex.size=100*V(g.L)$degree,
         xlim=xlim.g.L, ylim=ylim.g.L, layout=layout.g.L,
         vertex.color=V(g.L)$color.comm, edge.color=E(g.L)$color.comm,
         edge.width=log1p(E(g.L)$btwn))

Let me know if you have other questions,
Chris

messages.subject: Update to v0.65.0
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I have made an update to v0.65.0.

New function: "permute.group.auc" is almost the same as "permute.group", except it does permutation testing for the difference (between 2 groups) in the area-under-the-curve (AUC) of a graph measure (e.g. global efficiency) across all densities. The function "plot_perm_diffs" has been updated to work with this data, but only works at the vertex level.

There was an error in some cases with "NBS" if the permuted data resulted in a graph with 0 connected components. This has been fixed.
You can now provide a "covars" data.table to the function "brainGraph_init" (used with volumetric data); this is so you can subset the data yourself, if you wish. This also means that you no longer *need* a file named "covars.csv" in the specific directory.

You can see more changes at the Github page <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/acca7eebe108f1b423761488ceed831a093230a2?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3>
I have not yet updated the User Guide to reflect these changes, but hope to soon.

Chris
